text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black ran in the Satsuki Sho, 
giving it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, after the race, they spot the 
Brusque Man camp surrounded by reporters. 
It seems they cannot match her level of 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However,
the Classic Triple Crown has only 
just begun.
Rallied by Sakura Bakushin O's 
boundless energy,
Kitasan Black dashed off once more.
